---
title: "Corrections"
description: "Every correction made to a chart or page on Ireland by Numbers."
---

Mistakes in a chart, a figure or the text of a page are corrected as soon as they are found, and every correction is listed here with the date, what was wrong and what was changed. Routine updates, when a source publishes new or revised figures, are not corrections and are listed on the [What's new](whats-new.qmd) page instead.

To report an error, email [irelandbynumbers@proton.me](mailto:irelandbynumbers@proton.me) or open an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/irelandbynumbers/irelandbynumbers.ie/issues/new?template=data-correction.yml). The full change history of every page is public in the [site's repository](https://github.com/irelandbynumbers/irelandbynumbers.ie/commits/main).

## Corrections made

No corrections have been made so far.
